description: Public side of the same website as the capture/evaluation tool (public vs. admin split). Lists available paintings with title, real size and price; buying via Stripe; shipping choice pick-up or shipped.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Offering both free pick-up and fairly priced shipping widens the buyer pool without losing money on large paintings
Computed prices are what the shop displays and charges
Size-appropriate, compressed variants keep the grid and painting pages fast while the archive keeps full quality
supportingConnections.reflection: Held in local test: thumb ~2.8 KB vs. ~24 KB archive for a 1200x800 synthetic image; real page-speed effect untested until real paintings exist.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Named paintings are more appealing to buyers than 'Untitled'
